children: European stock indexes open in the red, with higher borrowing costs and stubbornly high oil prices weighing on sentiment. Banking and technology stocks slide as the Stoxx Europe 600 drops 0.4%. London's FTSE 100 slips 0.3%. Insurance group Standard Life slips 4.4% as financials drag on the index. In Frankfurt, the energy-sensitive DAX is down 0.5%. Defense group Rheinmetall falls 2%, while automakers broadly drop. BMW loses 2.6%. BNP Paribas falls 4.3% in Paris, helping drag the CAC 40 down 0.4%. French automakers also fall, though a cautious rally in luxury stocks helps soften losses. LVMH rises 0.8%. Italy's FTSE MIB falls 0.5%, while the Spanish IBEX 35 slips around 0.4%. The technology-heavy Dutch AEX edges 0.15% lower as ASML loses 0.4%.(josephmichael.stonor@wsj.com)
